items.title: A finite partition of a Noetherian space is refined by a finite good stratification
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that every finite partition of a Noetherian topological space is refined by a finite good stratification (author lemma at source lines 5847-5851, label lemma-noetherian-partition-refined-by-stratification). The proof (source lines 5853-5877) finds an open subset of the space inside one piece along an irreducible component, splits the partition along that open subset so that the complement is a strictly smaller closed subset, and concludes by Noetherian induction (proof lines 5853-5876). The splitting of the partition and the induction are the content. H3.
